source: Ministerial Decision No. 197 of 2026 · Effective 1 October 2026
headline: E-INVOICE DATA
CAN NOW LIVE

blocks.text: E-invoice data must be stored inside the UAE.

items: Storage abroad is fine if records stay **available to the FTA**.
Issue and transmit within **14 business days**.
VAT group internal invoices excluded until **31 Dec 2028**.
